name: call-me
description: Talk to your Claude Code sessions by voice through the Talkif app: ask them questions, give them tasks, and let them call you when they need you.

apiKey.title: Talkif API key
apiKey.description: From the Talkif dashboard (Developer → Credentials) with the scopes Connectors, Calls (read) and Flows (read). Stored in your keychain, never in settings.json.

apiUrl.title: API URL (advanced)
apiUrl.description: Leave empty for Talkif (https://api.talkif.ai). Only change it if Talkif support tells you to.

flowId.title: Flow
flowId.description: The id of the flow your calls run on. Empty: the first published flow with a Connectors node (/cm setup shows which).

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Only sessions in these folders join (comma-separated, ~/ allowed). Empty: every session; /cm on|off still decide.

debug.title: Debug traffic pane
debug.description: Record this session's call-me traffic and show it with /cm traffic.

parallel.title: Queue tasks while busy
parallel.description: Accept more tasks from a call while one runs (they queue) instead of declining.

callback.title: Ring back when a call task ends
callback.description: When a task given on a call finishes or gets stuck after the call ended, ring you with the result.

callTasks.title: Tasks from calls
callTasks.description: read-only: while a task given on a call runs, tools that change anything are refused and the session reports what it would change. session: the session's own Claude Code permissions apply. The plugin never grants a permission in either mode.

agentKey.title: Personal Agent credential
agentKey.description: Personal Agent credential (tif_agent_…) from Talkif settings. Makes this session one of your connected agents. Stored in your keychain, never in settings.json. Empty: Personal Agent is off.

peerTasks.title: Tasks from your other agents
peerTasks.description: read-only: tasks from your other connected agents never change anything on this machine. follow-hub: they may make local changes when you set that agent to auto in Talkif and the task was granted a write; outward actions (push, deploy, messages, secrets) always wait for your approval.

voiceApprovals.title: Approvals said on a call
voiceApprovals.description: deny: an outward action (push, merge, sending) approved by voice on a Talkif call does not run here; only your passkey approves it. allow: a voice yes on your own call is enough for those (never for secrets, payments or deploys).
